title: By the Oaks of Mamre
text: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day …

title: He Ran to Meet Them
text: … he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.

title: Under the Tree
text: … he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate.

title: Sarah Will Have a Son
text: I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!

title: Too Difficult for the LORD?
text: Is anything too difficult for the LORD?

title: God Has Made Me Laugh
text: God has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me.

title: Father of Many Nations
text: … your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

title: Abraham Laughed Too
text: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed …

title: Entertaining Angels
text: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

title: By Faith Sarah
text: By faith Sarah … considered Him faithful who had promised.
